name: Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

information:
## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025!

### Make sure you check out [Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025) taking place on May 30th - June 1st in Edinburgh!


### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. However, this is a blind events specialist events competition, so we do not recommend this competition to beginners or first time competitors.


#### Prizes:
As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ScottishChampionshipBlindOff2025#55048-prizes) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete.

Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above.
